description: Ministry of  Labour & Trade Union Relations - Notify the Industrial Disputes between S. Maduraweeran and Bank of Ceylon  ; G. G. N. Ranathunga and Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act. It involves the appointment of arbitrators for industrial disputes, revocation of previous orders, and statutory procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a minister's name (Ravindra Samaraweera), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content focuses on legal procedures and regulatory actions under established labor laws.
